create_nuclear_industry.ponder.experimen: Experimental Reactor: Formation and Safe Control
A fixed 5x5x5 reactor starts with its casing and valid side interfaces.
This temporary teaching cutaway exposes the three-high fuel columns, control-rod columns, and empty columns.
The instrument port is the sole reactor state owner and the required wrench diagnosis point.
A newly formed reactor leaves every movable control rod fully inserted.
Every player may adjust each drive with its own server-validated Create-style slider.
Multiple cold ports may feed one shared coolant ledger; they do not create separate reactor state.
Multiple hot ports independently accept output capacity, with no hidden whole-reactor flow cap.
A sustained high redstone signal at the instrument port requests SCRAM and inserts movable rods.
Removing the signal restores the pre-SCRAM target depths; SCRAM never deletes fuel or residual heat.
